## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `refactor` — code change with no feature or fix
- [ ] `chore` — tooling, deps, CI
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only

## Checklist

- [ ] Lint, type-check, and build pass locally (`npm run lint && npm run check && npm run build`)
- [ ] No console errors; no new CLS; reduced-motion path works; keyboard access works
- [ ] All visible content and SEO come from Strapi (no hard-coded strings)
- [ ] Security headers intact; no secrets in code
- [ ] Lighthouse ≥ 90 in all four categories on mobile and desktop for affected pages
- [ ] `docs/PROGRESS.md` updated
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (`feat(web):`, `fix(cms):`, etc.)
